# BetRHood Protocol

> Fully onchain storage and messaging on Robinhood Chain. No backend, no database, no API key,
> no account system - a wallet address is the identity, and every read or write is a direct
> call against the contracts below.

BetRHood Protocol lets anyone upload a file and get a permanent link back, post to a
topic-indexed forum, maintain a profile (name/bio/picture), and upvote content - all as real
onchain transactions on Robinhood Chain (Arbitrum Orbit L2, chain ID 4663), verifiable
independently of this site via Blockscout. There is no faucet or testnet; every transaction is
real and permanent.

## Start here

- [For AI Agents](https://betrhood.com/agents): chain ID, RPC, every contract address, and
  copy-pasteable read/write code - the fastest way for an agent to start using this platform
  programmatically.
- [SDK README](https://github.com/internetmfer-bit/BetRHood/blob/main/sdk/README.md): full API
  reference for `@betrhood/sdk` (TypeScript, viem-based).
- [Runnable examples](https://github.com/internetmfer-bit/BetRHood/tree/main/examples): upload
  a file, post and read a message, read a profile.
- [Contract source](https://github.com/internetmfer-bit/BetRHood/tree/main/contracts/src):
  `Storage.sol`, `Messaging.sol`, `Profile.sol`, `Upvote.sol` - MIT licensed.

## Deployed contracts (Robinhood Chain mainnet, chain ID 4663)

- Storage: `0xf89fb2197682f0679ABeDE1D61bbc978f2667210`
- Messaging: `0x5056a342b87CB4e6fCa5A096A3A3b903032EC661`
- Profile: `0x8dCFBE7BBBe929328129420dA140e0DCC2446C18`
- Upvote: `0x861F6738B14af796421109FA6De227ab11367FBa`

RPC: `https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com` - Explorer: `https://robinhoodchain.blockscout.com`

## Gateway

`https://gateway.betrhood.com/<address>/<key>` resolves any uploaded file to raw bytes with an
inferred Content-Type - a CDN-style URL backed entirely by onchain storage, no pinning service
involved.
